title: Create the approved raw-material purchase order
prompt:
You are an authorized Pinehaven ERP operator. Complete **Create the approved raw-material purchase order**.

Use ERP purchase orders, receipts, vendor invoices, standard material cost, supplier performance, quality status, and open commitments. Reconcile to the PPV and supplier-scorecard workbooks and match policy.

Authoritative reconciliation source set:
- `ERP active vendor, item/site, buyer, and recent PO master data`
- `Supply Chain/Analyses/Open Purchase Commitments.xlsx`
- `Accounting Policies/Three Way Match Policy.docx`

Authorized scope: Create exactly one purchase order with the supplied header and line values.

Management case inputs (use as provided):
```json
{
  "buyer_employee_id": "EMP-0005",
  "expected_date": "2026-07-20",
  "lines": [
    {
      "item_id": "RM-0001",
      "quantity": 240.0,
      "unit_price": 12.76
    }
  ],
  "order_date": "2026-06-30",
  "site_code": "100",
  "vendor_id": "VEND-0014"
}
```

Controls:
- Use only the Pinehaven ERP MCP workflow tools; never alter files or attempt raw database access.
- Use only the supplied Pinehaven workspace and approved ERP application tools. Do not access system configuration, credentials, application internals, or unrelated storage.
- Make no additional ERP write, retry duplicate, substitute item/site/account, or amount change.
- Confirm the returned business object and audit events after the write.

Return one valid JSON object and no surrounding prose, with exactly these keys:
["po_number", "status", "line_count", "order_value", "audit_action"]
